label: Bible Study
prompt: But the LORD is in his holy temple: let all the earth keep _____ before him.
verse: But the LORD is in his holy temple: let all the earth keep silence before him.
note: After a string of woes against idols, the true God appears — and everyone hushes.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing _____.
verse: Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms.
note: James's simple prescription: troubled? pray. Merry? sing psalms. Both roads lead to God.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending unto him, as it had been a great _____ knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:
verse: And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending unto him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:
note: Peter's rooftop vision: a great sheet let down by its four corners, full of creatures he'd never eat.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be _____ blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verse: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
note: Spirit, soul and body — Paul prays for the whole person to be kept blameless until Christ comes.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Brethren, I count not myself to have _____: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,
verse: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,
note: Paul admits he hasn't 'apprehended' — laid hold of — the prize yet. So: forget what's behind and reach forward.
